title: Bunzee.ai: Idea → IA → wireframes → design → build via MCP | Product Hunt
excerpt: AI can't build your app right without context—it's just guessing the next token. Bunzee gives it the full picture: it analyzes your idea against real competitors and market data, then breaks everything into structured specs—PRD, IA, wireframes, and designs you can shape from 250+ global app styles. Each step feeds the next, and every one is grounded in objective data, not opinion. Then it all pipes to your AI coding tool over MCP, so your AI builds from real context, not vibes.
